content.text:
I reviewed each answer-key item against the record, checking figures against the meeting's final numbers (the $68,400 correction from "86,000", the $19,000 roof, the October 2 listing date, and Imani's reassignment of the umbrella quote).

**Matching summary**

| Key | Record | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| e1 | 1 | $1,049,000 combined appraisal correct |
| e2 | 3 | Nov 10, 2026 knee replacement correct |
| a1 | 4 | $68,400 ACH — uses corrected figure |
| a2 | 6 | $43,400 to moderate model |
| a3 | 5 | $25,000 reserve, cash/money market |
| i1 | 7 | Gavin, Sept 25 |
| i2 | 11 | Imani (reassigned from Anneliese), Sept 29, $2M |
| i3 | 8 | Gavin, Oct 2 (not the superseded Sept 18) |
| i4 | 9 | Gavin, Oct 31 |
| i5 | 10 | Imani, Sept 16 |
| i6 | 13 | Celeste, Dec 8 |
| i7 | 12 | Celeste, week of Sept 28 |

All twelve key items are captured, with correct figures, owners and dates throughout. No NOT-ACTION item (Maren gift, LLC, selling the duplex, 1031, investing the ~$550k proceeds) leaked into the record as an action. One unpaired record item (#2, the $68,400 trust distribution logged as a life event) is directly established by the transcript at [00:21:46] and states the corrected amount; it describes the receipt of funds rather than restating the ACH transfer in #4, so I treat it as supported rather than duplicate.

key_items.note: Captures the inherited Dayton/Kettering rentals with the correct $1,049,000 date-of-death appraisal total. Does not name the death date or step-up, but the event is captured; no wrong figures.
Right-knee replacement on November 10, 2026 recorded correctly; six-week absence omitted but no figure is wrong.
ACH pull of $68,400 from checking into the joint brokerage account. Uses the corrected $68,400, not the retracted $86,000.
$43,400 into the moderate model in the joint brokerage account; matches the post-correction split.
Second joint account, cash only/money market, funded with $25,000 as the property reserve.
All four appraisals plus Denise's rent ledger to Rick Dunleavy; owner Gavin, due Sept 25, 2026 (end of next week). Copying Celeste and the land/building split are omitted detail, not errors.
$2 million umbrella plus the two landlord policies; correctly reassigned to Imani Rourke rather than Anneliese, due Sept 29, 2026.
Listing agreement with Tamsin, Gavin as owner, due October 2, 2026 — the revised date, not the superseded Friday Sept 18.
Interview property managers and pick one; Gavin, by October 31, 2026, matching 'before Denise stops' on the 31st.
ACH authorization and new account application for e-signature; Imani Rourke, due September 16, 2026 ('by tomorrow').
Rerun of the retirement projection with the updated retirement target and rental income; Celeste, due December 8, 2026 ahead of the December meeting. No figures stated, so none can be wrong.
Joint call with Rick Dunleavy and Hollis on seller identity and the tax questions; Celeste, week of September 28, 2026.

extra_items.note: The August trust distribution of $68,400 is established at [00:05:03] and corrected at [00:21:46]; the record uses the corrected figure. It logs the receipt of the funds, which is distinct from the ACH transfer action in item 4, so it is not a restatement of another record item.
